[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Plains of Jarin | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=430 }} The [[Plains of Jarin]] are the dusty plains of northeastern [[Istan]]. They are mostly flat and dry, but the southeastern part of the Plains of Jarin is more verdant. A variety of [[sentient plant]]s and [[insect]]s inhabit this explorable area, together with a large population of [[skale]]s at the western waterways. == Getting there == The Plains of Jarin connects [[Kamadan]] and three other outposts. Leaving Kamadan for the first time using the northwestern exit will bring players here. A variety of quests available in Kamadan and the [[Sunspear Great Hall]] lead to and take place here. == Exits == * [[Caverns Below Kamadan]] (southeast, via the [[Fissure]], only for those with access to [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]) * [[Champion's Dawn]] (southwest) * [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] (southeast) * [[Sunspear Great Hall]] (center) * [[The Astralarium]] (northwest) == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Insect Hunt]]1 ** Center, at exit into [[Sunspear Great Hall]]. ** Northeastern corner of the Sunspear Great Hall structure. * Sunspear Scout → [[Plant Hunt]]1 ** East, at exit into [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]. ** Shoreline southwest from Kamadan. ** Southwest, at exit into [[Champion's Dawn]]. * Sunspear Scout → [[Skale Hunt]]2 ** In the center of the western water channel. ** Northwest, at exit into [[the Astralarium]]. 1 In [[normal mode]], only for characters below [[level]] 8 with [[Sunspear rank]] below 6.

Watch out for the lone hostile [[Irontooth Drake]] in their midst. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.7% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 209|low = 188|high = 229}} ** Be careful with the [[Popup|hidden]] [[mandragor]] groups near [[Tarom Rockbreaker]]; the [[boss]] itself is part of a hidden group. ** This area will yield about 1,800 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]] with all bounties. When vanquishing with non-Elonian characters this area will offer Istani bounties as long as you are below Sunspear rank 6. [[A Land of Heroes]] is the easier method for non-Elonian characters to reach rank 6. ** If the quest [[Zaishen Elite (quest)|Zaishen Elite]] is active, you must defeat the two Acolytes to successfully vanquish the area. ** The festival quest [[White Mist]] adds three allied [[Humbug]]s to your team. ** It is possible to vanquish this area with a party of eight members. See [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan#Notes|Kamadan, Jewel of Istan notes]] for details. *** It is also possible to get a party of eight members from the [[Sunspear Great Hall]] under the same conditions after completing [[Blacktide Den]] mission. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Flachland von Jarin]]
